hypothesis_text: An orchestrator-dispatched critic agent that scores hypotheses against a structured flaw taxonomy reduces post-hoc-rationale errors more than an unstructured critic prompt, even at fixed compute budget.
prior_art_summary: Critic / debate / self-refine patterns are studied (Constitutional AI; Self-Refine 2023; debate work 2023-25). Structured-taxonomy vs. unstructured-prompt comparison at fixed compute is an unexplored angle.
rationale: Sits in a busy area but identifies a comparison the literature hasn't run. Novel framing of a known mechanism.
